# HTMX

`htmx.min.js` is the unmodified distribution from HTMX 2.0.8:
https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/blob/v2.0.8/dist/htmx.min.js

SHA-256: `22283ef68cb7545914f0a88a1bdedc7256a703d1d580c1d255217d0a50d31313`
